sections.title: Distribute POs from org… in UIT? Negative!
paragraphs: We all want to see what our outgoing POs will look like in UIT , but there ’s much safer options tha n enabling this “Production Only ” setting … Why risk the accidental distribution and possib le fulfillment of a test PO in UIT? OPTION 1: JAGGAER Only – PO Distribution from PO Search Results Using “Resend PO to Supplier ”
